notes.text: The documented object is Victor Pakomio's carved portrait, distinct from the person represented. The page's lantern-slide illustration is a historical photograph of Nua María Aŋata credited to Katherine Routledge and the British Museum, not a photograph of this bust. The biographical narrative concerns the sitter; it does not establish the bust's making date or provenance. No accession number is established. A usable HTML capture was inspected on 30 September 2026, including the expanded transcript. It embeds Indigenous cultural images for which redistribution is not cleared under the museum’s image licensing procedure (https://australian.museum/about/organisation/am-images/). The complete capture remains in ignored local storage; no shareable capture or publishable image is registered.

claims.value: created by ‘Aŋata’s great-great grandson, Victor Pakomio
